versions.content: Describe Special Data which only applies for specific variants Type: valid Description: The Generic Structure Template shall support the description of Special Data (used to store arbitrary data for which no other element exists of the AUTOSAR data model) being subject of variability. Thereby values of special data can be subject of variability and / or the existence of parts of the Special Data can be subject of variability Rationale: Describe proprietary non-AUTOSAR information which relates to variant rich AUTOSAR models.
